TRANSIENT_LIMITS.doc: The legal range of each transient-designer field (engineering units), transient spec §3. Every kind comes up flat: no per-kind default differs. `harness/contract-limits-gen.mjs` emits each as `OMX_TRANSIENT_<FIELD>_{MIN,MAX,DEFAULT}` for `mix_transient.h`'s resolve; the row publishes them on OPTIONS when it lands (issue #921).

TRANSIENT_FAST_ATTACK_MS.doc: The fast follower's attack, ms: exactly the dynamics detector's no-oversampling line (transient spec §3, L7).

TRANSIENT_FAST_RELEASE_MS.doc: The fast follower's release, ms: one 50 Hz cycle held, a 180 bpm sixteenth forgotten (transient spec §3).

TRANSIENT_REF_DB.doc: The contrast, dB, at which a knob reaches its full value (transient spec §2, §3).

TRANSIENT_FLOOR_LIN.doc: The detector floor, linear (−100 dBFS): below it both envelopes read the floor and the stage is unity (transient spec §3).
